Claire —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached are two editable stubs: MAP_Template_Harmonix_Q4.gdoc (link below) and 30d_Acceptance_Slate.gslides. High level approach in the MAP: a three-phase plan (Kickoff & Data Prep / Tech Validation / Acceptance & Handoff). Each phase has gating criteria and named owners.

Quick outline (pulling from the doc):
- Kickoff (Week 0): stakeholder roster, NDA/procurement contacts, kickoff workshop. Owner: Jordan (Redwood) / Claire (Harmonix)
- Tech validation (Weeks 1–2): perf/cost baseline, sample dataset run, KV cache verification. Gate: 95th pct latency below agreed SLO or agreed mitigation path. Owner: Marissa (Redwood engineering) / Harm Tech lead
- Acceptance window (Weeks 3–4): acceptance tests, regression prompts, production-like load test. Gate: acceptance matrix signed, minimal quality regression. Owner: Ben (Redwood CS) / Harm QA

I've called out a SOC2 evidence pass as part of Week 2 to unblock procurement. Also included an appendix with a suggested prompt set and sample sample-size for evals.

Attachments and links:
- MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aX-MAP-Harmonix-Q4
- Slide (30d acceptance): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1bY-30d-Acceptance-Slate
- Pilot timeline (spreadsheet): pilot_timeline.xlsx (attached stub)

Can you share the stakeholder roster and preferred procurement contact? I'll fold names into the owner column and update gating dates. Also propose a 45-minute kickoff on Monday Nov 29 10am PT — want to confirm availability.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
